sections.text: Introduction

The 
relay characteristics allow a great accuracy to recognize internal and external 
faults in generator / step up transformer / unit auxiliary transformer. It is 
manufactured by GE

This procedure details the steps required to 
completely check the proper operation and calibration of the TTS100B121G00 
relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases

The first preliminary steps to prepare for relay 
testing describes the activities required prior to testing. Some of these steps 
could be performed days before the actual test. The second section preparation 
for testing describes the steps to set up the equipment for performing the 
actual tests. The third section is the actual test

The first draft is initiated by eng. Saber Mohamed, 
tested by eng. Ragab Abd Elgwad, revised by eng. Abd Elazez Shalaby, 
accepted by eng. Mahmoud Badawy: Electrical maintenance & protection manager, 
approved by eng. Ahmed Moussa: executive operation & maintenance manager, 
and certified by eng. Gamal Abd El Wahab: quality control head sector & MPIS 
coordinator.
Safety Precautions

items: A work order must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the suitable safety ID category.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, anti static 
 hand probe to avoid electrical shock etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
The generator must be isolated and work permit required.

Make sure that CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the current 
 circuit for test current injection

Switch off DC power supply before inserting or withdrawing any card from the 
 relay module.

sections.text: Restraint characteristic test

First winding with 
second winding

Connect the 
circuit as in fig 2 and adjust the tester to I1 & I2

Short circuit 
the output of I1

Short circuit 
the output of I2
Press I

Press dynamic 
then press fault

Adjust I1 to 
0.6In

Press I and 
adjust I2 to 0.6In

Press Φ and 
adjust the angle to 0
Press static

Remove the short 
circuit of I1 & I2 output and connect the leads as follow:
for I1 red at A1, black at B1 & for I2 red at B5, black at A5

Press dynamic 
then press fault.

Decrease I2 
slowly until the relay picks up and the tester is stopped.

Record I1 & I2 
then calculate.

Mean bias = 
(I1+I2) / 2

Differential 
current = I1 - I2
